requests.zh: 整张毕业照偏亮，收一点整体曝光，保住衣服纹理，天空保持自然。
requests.en: Take the entire graduation photo down a little in exposure, retaining clothing texture and a natural sky.

requests.zh: 把室内合照整张稍微调暗，保留人物五官和衣服纹理。
requests.en: Darken the whole indoor group photo slightly, keeping facial features and clothing texture.

requests.zh: 整张赛车场照片明显压暗一档，车身和云层仍有纹理。
requests.en: Noticeably darken the entire race scene, retaining bodywork and cloud texture.

requests.zh: 让湖边照片整体稍微暗一点，别让人的脸和前景黑成一片。
requests.en: Darken the entire lake photo a little, keeping the faces and foreground legible.

requests.zh: 把整张背光人像曝光降低一点，保留脸和亮叶子的细节。
requests.en: Lower exposure a little across the whole backlit portrait, preserving the face and bright leaf detail.

requests.zh: 整幅照片明显压暗一点，包含水面和天空，留住衣服纹理。
requests.en: Noticeably darken the whole photograph, including the water and sky, while keeping clothing detail.

requests.zh: 整体轻轻压暗山谷景色，保留晚霞暖色和前景植被。
requests.en: Gently darken the whole valley scene, retaining warm sunset colours and the foreground vegetation.

requests.zh: 稍微降低整张照片的曝光，保持天空亮云和水面纹理自然。
requests.en: Slightly lower exposure across the entire photo, keeping bright clouds and water texture natural.

requests.zh: 整张观景照片明显压暗，保留岩石、云纹和远山层次。
requests.en: Make the entire overlook photograph noticeably darker, while preserving rock, cloud and mountain detail.

requests.zh: 整张人像轻微压暗，头发和眼睛仍然清楚。
requests.en: Slightly darken the entire portrait while keeping the eyes and hair clear.

requests.zh: 整体收暗一点，保留肤色和背景亮处的过渡，不要让高光发灰。
requests.en: Bring the whole portrait down a little, keeping natural skin and bright-background gradients without turning the highlights grey.

requests.zh: 整张照片稍微压暗，保留肤色、衣服亮处和草地颜色。
requests.en: Slightly darken the whole photograph, retaining skin, bright clothing and the grass colours.

requests.zh: 整幅照片轻轻调暗，人物的脸和建筑纹理仍能看清。
requests.en: Gently darken the entire photograph, keeping the face and building texture readable.

requests.zh: 整张照片明显压暗，受光背景和人物都要暗下来，五官仍能辨认。
requests.en: Noticeably darken the whole photograph, including the lit background and the person, while keeping facial features recognizable.

requests.zh: 整张山丘风景稍微压暗，保住草纹和自然天空过渡。
requests.en: Darken the whole hillside scene slightly, preserving grass texture and a natural sky gradient.

requests.zh: 整体曝光明显降低，天空和林冠一起压暗，不能出现均匀灰块。
requests.en: Noticeably reduce the exposure of the entire scene, darkening the sky and forest together without a uniform grey block.

requests.zh: 整张城市晚霞明显压暗，保留建筑轮廓和橙色云层的层次。
requests.en: Noticeably darken the whole city sunset, retaining the building shapes and layers in the orange clouds.

requests.zh: 整张海面日落稍微压暗，保留太阳附近的亮度渐变和水纹。
requests.en: Darken the whole sunset seascape slightly, preserving the gradient near the sun and the water texture.

requests.zh: 只压暗阳光照到的地方，树荫原样。
requests.en: Only darken the sunlit areas; leave the shade unchanged.

requests.zh: 最亮的部分亮度降一点，阴影别动。
requests.en: Lower only the brightest highlights without changing the shadows.

requests.zh: 整体压暗一点，再给画面加棕褐色。
requests.en: Slightly darken the whole image and then add a sepia tone.

requests.zh: 整张照片保持原样，曝光不用改。
requests.en: Leave the entire photo as it is, with no exposure change.

requests.zh: 整张图提高些亮度，保留阴影里的层次。
requests.en: Brighten the entire image while retaining detail in the shadows.

requests.zh: 只把树下阴影压暗，亮天空不动。
requests.en: Darken only the shadows below the trees, leaving the bright sky alone.

requests.zh: 把阴影提亮，同时把整张照片调暗一些。
requests.en: Lift the shadows and also darken the whole photo a little.

requests.zh: 要不要把全图曝光收一点？先告诉我你的看法。
requests.en: Should the exposure come down across the frame? Tell me what you think first.

image_method: CPU. Ten known, previously rendered original groups for fit (five portraits/five landscapes), eight source-isolated original groups for held visual test (four portraits/four landscapes). Every image has one literal bilingual overall-darkening request and the same four candidate recipes. No final acceptance. Review full frame and matched native crops before fitting/reading predictions.
image_fit: StandardScaler and regularized logistic (C=.3, class-balanced, no tune) on fixed image/recipe features and visual complete vs other. Leave-one-fit-original-out scores calibrate threshold: among finite thresholds retain max complete with no incomplete choices on grouped fit calibration, ties prefer fewer deliveries then higher threshold. Refit on all ten groups. Fixed recipes, image-only deterministic comparator and fitted selector are evaluated with correct-route oracle. No guaranteed performance.
feature_scope: Only input and candidate pixels, explicit mild/noticeable term from request, recipe magnitude and shoulder indicator. No source ID, reference or label at prediction. Largest connected neutral-white source plate, input low tone, mean plate fall, shadow burden increase and midtone change are diagnostic features.
route_method: Use frozen R29 augmented head with its original prompt, compare raw versus a strict separate operative-clause polarity/scope agreement guard. On disagreement, unclear or mixed text, no edit in the protected path. Test new photos and eight fresh textual controls plus known R29 false routes. Only global-down routes enter this isolated image selector. Raw other positive routes are text-only on controls.
acceptance: Report actual visual completion and visibly failed deliveries, including where a safe-looking mild result missed noticeable intent. No promotion from this small single AI review.
